resume: Six freely assignable tracks and twelve sound engines, partly taken from Mutable Instruments' Plaits, Rings and Elements: 224 factory sounds and 76 Biomes, small sound worlds that unfold by themselves, with generated rhythms, a granular bus, and shared delay and room.

commandes.role: Keyboard one octave down; the sequence notes do not change.
Keyboard one octave up; the sequence notes do not change.
The GRANULAR BUS, TAPE / MOTION, SHARED SPACE and MARBLES / TIDES / WARPS pages, one after another. On GRANULAR BUS: K1 mix, K2 grain length, K3 position, K4 feedback.
Mutes or unmutes the chosen track.
Undoes the last variation; only one is kept.
Freezes the granular memory: the cloud keeps playing; again, recording resumes.
The track's SOUND, VELVET FILTER, ENVELOPE / BLOOM, MIX / NOTES and GLOBAL MIXER pages, one after another.
The HARMONY / GLOBAL, QUALITY / SYSTEM, LOOK / STARTUP, MIDI / PERFORMANCE and USER BANKS pages.
LIVE BIOME page: K1 DENSITY (number of events), K2 MOTION (melodic movement), K3 COLOUR (brighter or darker), K4 SPACE (granular level).
Keeps the Biome and the preferences; only when stopped, on the internal clock.
Locks the random seed: the same seed repeats.
The RHYTHM, GROOVE / REPEATS, BASS / MOTIFS and PHRASE / NOTES pages. On RHYTHM: hits, length, rotation, and on K4 the event probability.
Starts and stops; when stopped, the sound decays by itself; starting again restarts the sequence.
New variation of the seed and rhythms. On QUALITY / SYSTEM and MIDI / PERFORMANCE: panic, everything goes silent, the tape too.
Chooses one of the six tracks.
One of the track's 224 sounds or one of the 76 Biomes (or Blank), depending on the page: the bottom bar says PRESET: TONE or PRESET: BIOME.
Changes the chosen track's sound engine (twelve), and opens the SOUND page.
Play the chosen track; the first key is F3.

gestes: Hold a button: its help shows, with no other effect; releasing it does nothing.
a_savoir: The granular audio is not saved.
